panels.qian: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing HEAVEN: a celestial vault of concentric gold rings, spiral sun discs and scattered gold star dots among rows of stylized auspicious cloud scrolls outlined in thin gold cloisonne lines, pale grey blue sky rendered with soft diluted ink wash, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.kun: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing EARTH: gently rolling fertile fields laid out as a patchwork of geometric ochre, umber and muted green rectangles and furrow stripes like a Klimt meadow, tiny gold flowers and seeds scattered across them, soft ink wash mist between the field bands, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.zhen: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing THUNDER: dark grey blue storm clouds built from repeating square spiral thunder meander patterns, thin zigzag gold lightning lines branching between them, rhythmic concentric rings of rumbling sound, soft diluted ink wash rain haze, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.kan: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing WATER: rhythmic rows of stylized waves and curling crests outlined in thin gold cloisonne lines, deep grey blue and indigo water rendered with soft diluted ink wash, small gold leaf flecks on the crests, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.gen: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing MOUNTAIN: overlapping ranges of stylized flat mountain peaks in layered rows, each peak outlined in thin gold cloisonne lines and filled with ochre, slate grey and muted grey blue, ink wash mist drifting through the valleys, tiny gold pine clusters on the ridges, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.dui: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing a LAKE and MARSH: a still lake surface rendered as overlapping concentric gold ripple rings and calm reflective bands, scattered lotus leaves, water lilies and slender reeds outlined in thin gold cloisonne lines, pale celadon and grey blue water with soft diluted ink wash, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.li: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing FIRE: rows of stylized rising flame tongues drawn as flowing Art Nouveau curves in muted vermilion, ochre and antique gold, small radiant sun discs and drifting sparks between them, thin gold cloisonne outlines, soft diluted ink wash smoke, on an aged ivory silk ground
panels.xun: a flat ornamental panel symbolizing WIND: long flowing parallel wind lines and spiral gusts sweeping across the canvas through bending grasses, willow branches and drifting leaves, outlined in thin gold cloisonne lines, muted grey blue and soft green with diluted ink wash, on an aged ivory silk ground

1.zh: 取六爻的「龍」：一條掐絲金龍穿過祥雲盤旋而上，象徵剛健不息。
1.en: a majestic celestial dragon coiling upward in an S curve among a few small stylized cloud scrolls, its body made of gold cloisonne scales with inlaid jade and lapis cabochons, mane and whiskers as flowing Art Nouveau vine curves

2.zh: 取卦辭「利牝馬之貞」：白色母馬披著金色幾何鞍布安穩前行，柔順而能行遠。
2.en: a gentle white mare walking calmly forward in three quarter view, head slightly lowered, wearing a gold geometric saddle cloth with inlaid jewel cabochons and ochre tassels, her mane and tail flowing like soft ink wash vines, small gold leaf flecks drifting around her

3.zh: 取「屯」字的字形：一株嫩芽從龜裂的硬土中彎曲頂出，金色雨滴落下，象徵萬物初生之難。
3.en: a young green sprout bursting up through a cracked mound of dark earth and stone, its stem bending and curling like an Art Nouveau tendril as it pushes through the hard crust, two unfurling leaves edged in gold cloisonne, a few gold raindrops falling around it, the earth mound decorated with geometric gold inlay

4.zh: 取「童蒙求我」與「山下出泉」：孩童手持竹簡，跪在山石旁看著湧出的泉水。
4.en: a young child in a robe patterned with small gold geometric squares and spirals, kneeling beside a small clear spring that wells up from beneath a rounded rock, holding a bamboo scroll and gazing at the water with quiet curiosity, the rock and spring form one compact group with the child

5.zh: 取大象「雲上於天」與九五「需于酒食」：旅人在雲下安坐，備好茶酒，耐心等待時機。
5.en: a calm scholar in a patterned robe seated cross legged on a woven mat, a small teapot and wine cups on a low lacquered tray before him, gazing upward patiently at a few small gathering rain clouds above him

6.zh: 取大象「天與水違行」：兩位長者背對而立，各持文書，衣袖向相反方向揚起，象徵爭訟與分歧。
6.en: two robed elders standing back to back and facing opposite directions, one turned to the left and one turned to the right, each clutching a rolled scroll to his chest with arms crossed, stern expressions, their long sleeves and sashes sweeping out in opposite directions

7.zh: 取卦辭「師貞，丈人吉」：老成持重的將領身披金甲，手持令旗，象徵有紀律的眾人與統帥。
7.en: a seasoned elderly Chinese general in ornate Tang dynasty mingguang armor with round chest plates, standing steady and composed, holding a tall command banner that shows only geometric pattern and a sheathed Chinese sword at his side

8.zh: 取卦辭「比，吉」與大象「地上有水」：三位同伴並肩挽臂而立，象徵親近、相輔與團結。
8.en: three young Chinese companions in hanfu robes standing close together shoulder to shoulder with arms linked, warm and friendly expressions, forming one compact united group

9.zh: 取卦辭「密雲不雨」：牧童以繩輕牽小牛，頭上密雲聚而未雨，象徵以柔制剛、小有蓄積。
9.en: a young Chinese herd boy with his hair tied in two small buns, wearing a simple hanfu tunic and straw sandals, gently holding a small calf on a loose rope, a few dense small rain clouds gathered above them with no rain falling

10.zh: 取卦辭「履虎尾，不咥人」：一人小心翼翼踩在老虎尾後，老虎回首卻不傷人。
10.en: a barefoot figure in a flowing robe stepping carefully and gracefully just behind a large calm tiger, one foot about to tread on its tail, the tiger looking back peacefully without anger

11.zh: 取大象「天地交，泰」：枝根對稱交纏、春花盛開的樹與一對燕子，象徵天地之氣相交、通泰安和。
11.en: a flourishing peach tree in full spring blossom whose branches and roots mirror each other in perfect symmetry, a pair of swallows flying around its crown

12.zh: 取大象「天地不交，否，君子以儉德辟難，不可榮以祿」與九五「繫于苞桑」：布衣君子捧著收起官帽與印綬的木匣，轉身走離緊閉的銅釘木門，門旁桑樹葉落而根深，枝頭微有新芽。
12.en: a Chinese gentleman in a plain cotton hanfu robe carrying an open wooden box that holds his folded official hat and seal ribbon, turning away from a tightly closed wooden gate studded with bronze bosses; the gate has straight lintel beams on two pillars and a short grey tiled roof and joins a short section of wall; beside it a leafless mulberry tree with deep firm roots and a few tiny buds at its branch tips; only a small patch of threshold ground beneath them

13.zh: 取卦辭「同人于野」：不同年紀的人圍著一團火聚在曠野，象徵與人同心、廣結志同道合者。
13.en: a small group of Chinese villagers of different ages in hanfu robes gathered around a bonfire, raising their hands together in fellowship

14.zh: 取大象「火在天上，大有」與九二「大車以載」：一輪金日高照，下方一輛古代木輪大車滿載禾穗、絲帛與玉璧，盛而不溢。
14.en: an ancient Chinese two wheeled wooden cart with sturdy spoked wheels, axle and shafts, its bed neatly loaded with golden grain sheaves, rolled bolts of silk and a few jade bi discs, full but not overflowing, a radiant golden sun disc shining directly above it with short rays lighting the cargo, only a little ground under the wheels

15.zh: 取大象「地中有山，謙」與初六「謙謙君子」：衣冠尊貴的君子深深鞠躬，雙手拱手作揖，尊而能下。
15.en: a dignified Chinese gentleman in a dark embroidered hanfu robe with a small gold crown, bowing deeply in a traditional Chinese gongshou salute with his left hand covering his right fist in front of his chest and his wide sleeves hanging down, humble and serene, standing on a small rock ledge

16.zh: 取大象「先王以作樂崇德」：擊鐘鼓起舞的樂人，象徵和樂、振奮與預作準備。
16.en: a joyful Chinese court musician in flowing Tang dynasty dance robes with long sleeves dancing as she strikes a hanging bronze bell and a small drum, ribbons flowing in rhythm

17.zh: 取卦名「隨」與大象「嚮晦入宴息」：少年提燈跟隨老者於暮色中前行，象徵順時而隨、擇善而從。
17.en: a young Chinese boy with hair tied in two buns holding a small glowing paper lantern, following an old Chinese guide in a hanfu robe with a topknot and a bamboo walking staff, both walking forward together at dusk

18.zh: 取「蠱」字器皿生蟲的本義：工匠修補生了蟲的古器，象徵整治積弊、撥亂反正。
18.en: an artisan seated carefully repairing a cracked ancient lacquered bowl with gold, a few small beetles crawling away from the old vessel

19.zh: 取大象「澤上有地，臨」：長者自高台俯臨，伸手照看，象徵親臨、督導與包容。
19.en: a benevolent elder official standing on a raised stone terrace looking down warmly, one hand extended in care and guidance

20.zh: 取卦辭「盥而不薦，有孚顒若」：祭祀前虔敬洗手的人，象徵觀察、瞻仰與以誠示人。
20.en: a solemn Chinese ritual officiant in Zhou dynasty ceremonial robes and a mian crown with hanging beads, washing hands in a bronze basin before a ceremony, devout and reverent expression

21.zh: 取彖傳「頤中有物，曰噬嗑」：金色狻猊咬斷口中的銅棒，象徵咬合障礙、明斷是非。
21.en: a fierce gilded guardian lion biting through a bronze rod held in its jaws, small sparks of lightning around the rod

22.zh: 取彖傳「文明以止，人文也」、六五「束帛戔戔」與上九「白賁，无咎」：素白衣冠的君子奉上一束朱絲繫起的白帛，腳邊素瓶插一枝白梅，文質相稱、由華返樸。
22.en: a Chinese gentleman with his hair tied under a simple cap, wearing a plain white hanfu robe with wide sleeves whose hems carry only fine gold cloud embroidery, respectfully holding out a modest bundle of plain white silk tied with a thin vermilion cord, a small plain clay vase holding a single sparse branch of white plum blossom at his feet

23.zh: 取卦名「剝」與上九「碩果不食」：枝葉落盡的樹頂端仍留一顆碩果，象徵剝落之後仍有生機。
23.en: a bare tree stripped of all its leaves, a single large golden fruit still hanging at the very top of its crown

24.zh: 取彖傳「復，其見天地之心乎」：雪中初綻的梅枝與一輪初升的小日，象徵一陽來復、冬至回春。
24.en: a white plum blossom branch blooming in fresh snow, a small rising sun disc glowing behind it

25.zh: 取大象「天下雷行，物與无妄，先王以茂對時育萬物」與彖傳「大亨以正，天之命也」：農人在春雷細雨中蹲身扶正幼苗，木耒靜靠一旁，新苗與覓食小鳥各得其所，順天而不妄作。
25.en: a Chinese farmer with a topknot in a plain cross collared short robe crouching calmly to straighten a young seedling with his hands, a simple wooden plough and a small seed basket leaning beside him, a small patch of soil with naturally spaced green sprouts and a little bird pecking nearby, a small cloud above with a light spring drizzle and one faint thin flash of lightning

26.zh: 取大象「天在山中，大畜」與「多識前言往行」：賢者坐於如山的竹簡之間，象徵涵養蓄德、厚積而後發。
26.en: a wise sage seated amid tall stacks of bamboo scrolls piled like small mountains around him, reading peacefully

27.zh: 取卦辭「觀頤，自求口實」、大象「慎言語，節飲食」與初九「舍爾靈龜」：君子端坐小案前，只有一缽五穀、一碟蔬菜與一盞清茶，放下筷子、口唇安閉，案旁伏著一隻靈龜。
27.en: a Chinese scholar with his hair tied under a small cap, wearing a plain cross collared robe, seated composedly on a low mat before a small wooden table that holds only one modest bowl of mixed grains, one small dish of greens and one cup of tea, he has just set down his chopsticks and rests one hand on his knee, lips calmly closed, a small tortoise resting quietly beside the table

28.zh: 取卦辭「棟橈」與九二「枯楊生稊」：彎曲的枯楊冒出新芽，象徵負荷過重的非常時刻與絕處逢生。
28.en: an old withered willow tree bending heavily under its own weight beside marsh water, fresh green shoots sprouting from its trunk

29.zh: 取卦辭「習坎，有孚，維心亨」：旅人持心專一，走過急流深谷上的獨木，象徵重重險陷中守信前行。
29.en: a determined Chinese traveler in a hanfu robe and straw sandals with hair in a topknot carefully crossing a narrow log bridge over a deep rushing gorge, arms out for balance, focused and steady

30.zh: 取彖傳「離，麗也」「重明以麗乎正」、大象「明兩作，大人以繼明照于四方」與卦辭「畜牝牛，吉」：青銅雙層油燈上下兩盞火焰穩定相續，燈旁伏著一頭溫順的母牛。
30.en: an ancient Chinese bronze two tiered oil lamp with a heavy round foot and a straight column holding an upper and a lower lamp dish, each showing oil, a wick and a steady golden flame, the two soft halos of light touching each other, a smaller gentle brown cow lying calmly beside the lamp base on a small shared ground

31.zh: 取彖傳「咸，感也」與卦辭「取女吉」：一對年輕男女相對而立，指尖相觸，象徵感應與相互吸引。
31.en: a young Chinese man and a young Chinese woman in hanfu robes standing face to face, their fingertips just touching, gentle and tender

32.zh: 取彖傳「恒，久也」：白髮夫婦攜手同行，象徵恆久不變的道。
32.en: an elderly Chinese couple with white hair tied in buns, wearing hanfu robes, walking together hand in hand, serene and devoted

33.zh: 取卦名「遯」：披蓑戴笠的隱者持杖退入山林，回首一望，象徵適時退避、保全自身。
33.en: an old Chinese hermit in a straw rain cape and a conical bamboo hat with a bamboo walking staff walking away toward distant misty mountains, glancing back over his shoulder once

34.zh: 取九三「羝羊觸藩，羸其角」：公羊奮力撞籬，角被纏住，象徵壯盛之時更要守正、不可妄動。
34.en: a powerful ram butting hard against a woven bamboo fence, its curled horns entangled in it

35.zh: 取大象「明出地上，晉」與卦辭「康侯用錫馬」：諸侯乘駿馬迎著初升的太陽前進，象徵晉升與光明前進。
35.en: a Chinese noble lord in Han dynasty court robes and a black guan hat riding forward on a fine horse toward a rising sun disc, confident and bright

36.zh: 取大象「明入地中，明夷」與初九「明夷于飛，垂其翼」：身著深色長袍的書生把燈藏在袖中，腳邊一隻垂翼的鳥，象徵韜光養晦。
36.en: a Chinese scholar in a dark hanfu robe with wide sleeves and a black gauze hat, carefully hiding a glowing paper lantern beneath his sleeve, a small wounded bird with a drooping wing resting at his feet

37.zh: 取大象「風自火出，家人」：婦人與孩子圍著爐火備餐，象徵家道與各守其位。
37.en: a Chinese mother in a hanfu robe with her hair in a bun and a small child with hair in two buns tending a warm cooking hearth together, a clay pot simmering over the fire, cozy family scene

38.zh: 取彖傳「二女同居，其志不同行」：兩名女子背對而坐、望向不同方向，象徵乖離中求同存異。
38.en: two young Chinese women in hanfu robes with black hair in elegant buns, sitting back to back, each looking in a different direction, calm but apart

39.zh: 取彖傳「見險而能止，知矣哉」與六四「往蹇來連」、九五「大蹇朋來」：披蓑戴笠的旅人在斷裂結冰的岩階前收腳停杖回身，同伴從平緩處伸手相接。
39.en: a Chinese traveler in a straw rain cape, conical bamboo hat, cross collared short robe and leg wraps, stopping before a broken ice covered rock step, pulling back his front foot and turning around with his bamboo staff planted, a companion in a cross collared robe standing on a lower gentle rock ledge behind him reaching out a hand to him, only a small shared patch of rock, the broken step and a little snow

40.zh: 取彖傳「雷雨作」與上六「公用射隼于高墉之上」：城牆上的射手張弓射隼，象徵困難解除、除去禍患。
40.en: an archer standing on the crenellated rampart of an old Chinese city wall with a small watchtower with upturned eaves, drawing a bow at a hawk in flight, rain beginning to fall, no European buildings, no domes, no spires

41.zh: 取卦辭「曷之用，二簋可用享」：以兩只簡樸的食器誠心供奉，象徵減損以益他、儉約而有誠。
41.en: a humble person kneeling and holding up two identical simple round bronze food vessels, one vessel in each hand, offering them with sincere devotion

42.zh: 取卦名「益」的損上益下：長者從大甕中將穀物倒入孩子的籃中，象徵施惠與增益。
42.en: a generous elderly Chinese man in a hanfu robe with a white beard and a topknot pouring golden grain from a large ceramic jar into a bamboo basket held up by a smiling Chinese child with hair in two buns

43.zh: 取彖傳「夬，決也」與卦辭「揚于王庭」：官員高舉笏板果決宣告，腳邊是斷開的鎖鏈，象徵剛決柔、果斷去除弊端。
43.en: a resolute official raising a jade tablet high and declaring firmly, a broken chain lying at his feet

44.zh: 取彖傳「姤，遇也，柔遇剛也」與大象「天下有風」：一位女子與一位士人在風中不期而遇，兩人同時止步、欠身為禮、保持分際，女子從容自主。
44.en: a Chinese woman in a neat cross collared ruqun robe and a Chinese scholar official wearing a guan cap meeting each other by chance where two short stone paths cross, both stopping at a respectful distance, each making a slight courteous bow with an open palm, the woman composed and self possessed, the wind lifting both their sleeves and sashes in the same direction

45.zh: 取彖傳「萃，聚也」與卦辭「王假有廟，用大牲吉」：眾人帶著祭品聚於宗廟，象徵聚合人心。
45.en: a small group of people gathered around a sacrificial ox and a bronze incense burner at a temple altar, solemn gathering

46.zh: 取大象「地中生木，升」：從地中向上生長的樹苗，枝幹如階梯盤旋而上，象徵循序上升、積小成大。
46.en: a young tree growing upward out of the earth, its trunk spiraling upward like steps toward the sky

47.zh: 取大象「澤无水，困」：疲憊的書生坐在枯樹與乾涸的池邊，手持空杯仍神色安定，象徵困境中守志。
47.en: a weary scholar seated under a withered tree beside a dried cracked pond, holding an empty cup yet calm and resolute

48.zh: 取彖傳「井養而不窮」與九五「井冽，寒泉食」：女子把提上井沿、盛滿清泉的木桶從桶口倒入旅人捧著的陶罐，桶底完整不漏。
48.en: a complete low round stone well with a simple wooden windlass, a Chinese woman in a cross collared robe resting a full wooden bucket on the well rim and tilting it with both hands so that clear water pours only from the bucket mouth into a clay jar held by a Chinese traveler in a plain robe, the bucket bottom intact and not leaking, the rope hanging loosely, clear water visible inside the well

49.zh: 取九五「大人虎變」：斑紋煥然一新的猛虎，象徵變革與去故。
49.en: a majestic tiger with glowing bold new stripes, its old fur flaking away as the new pattern emerges

50.zh: 取雜卦「鼎，取新也」：三足銅鼎下燃柴火、冒著蒸氣，象徵烹飪養賢、鼎新立制。
50.en: a three legged bronze ding cauldron decorated with ancient patterns, a small fire burning beneath it and steam rising

51.zh: 取卦辭「震驚百里，不喪匕鬯」：雷聲大作中，持匙與酒器的人從容不失，象徵臨震不亂、恐懼修省。
51.en: a composed man holding a ritual ladle and a wine vessel steady while thunder flashes around him, calm and smiling

52.zh: 取卦辭「艮其背，不獲其身」：背向而坐、靜止如山的修行者，象徵知止、當止則止。
52.en: a meditating figure seen from behind, seated perfectly still like a mountain, robe falling in calm folds

53.zh: 取彖傳「漸之進也，進以正」與初六至九五「鴻漸于干、磐、陸、木、陵」：三隻灰褐色鴻雁沿著水岸、磐石到高臺逐級升高的岩階依序前行，頂端一株小松根深穩固。
53.en: three grey brown wild geese with sturdy bodies, necks and legs clearly shorter than a crane, broad flat bills and webbed feet, walking calmly in a line step by step from a small patch of water edge up onto a flat boulder and then onto a higher broad rock terrace, a small pine with firm roots growing at the top, all footholds joined as one gently rising base

54.zh: 取卦名「歸妹」與上六「女承筐无實」：手捧竹筐、低首的新嫁娘，象徵婚姻與名分，也提醒守正知終。
54.en: a young Chinese bride wearing a phoenix crown with pearl tassels and an embroidered xiapei shawl, holding an empty bamboo basket, eyes lowered

55.zh: 取卦辭「王假之，勿憂，宜日中」與彖傳「日中則昃」：斗拱飛簷的重簷樓閣上方高懸正午烈日，閣中君王端坐、侍者分立，盛極之時當知盈虛。
55.en: an ancient Chinese double eaved hip and gable roof timber pavilion with clear dougong brackets, upturned flying eaves and lattice windows, a blazing noon sun disc directly above its roof with abundant golden rays, the lower rim of the sun disc just beginning to darken slightly

56.zh: 取大象「山上有火，旅」：背著行囊的旅人在山上的營火旁歇息，象徵羈旅在外、謹慎守正。
56.en: a lone traveler with a bundle on a staff resting beside a small campfire on a rocky mountain ledge

57.zh: 取彖傳「重巽以申命」與大象「隨風，巽，君子以申命行事」：君子展開無字竹簡宣讀命令，衣袂隨風，一旁受命者躬身承接，腳邊竹草順風俯偃。
57.en: a Chinese gentleman wearing a guan cap and a cross collared wide sleeved hanfu robe holding open a blank bamboo slip scroll and proclaiming an order, his sleeves and cap ribbons blowing in the wind, a humble attendant beside him bowing to receive the order with both hands raised, slender bamboo and grasses at their feet all bending in the same direction with the wind

58.zh: 取大象「麗澤，兌，君子以朋友講習」：兩位少女說笑相談，象徵喜悅與溝通。
58.en: two young Chinese girls in hanfu robes with black hair in buns and flower hairpins, laughing and conversing joyfully, one holding a lotus flower

59.zh: 取大象「風行水上，渙」：風帆鼓起的船行於破冰散開的水面，象徵離散與化解，也宜聚合人心。
59.en: a small sailing boat with its sail filled by wind gliding over rippling water, ice breaking apart and drifting around it

60.zh: 取卦名「節」：節理分明的竹與調節水流的小水閘，象徵節制有度，也提醒苦節不可長久。
60.en: a tall stalk of bamboo with prominent jointed nodes standing beside a small wooden sluice gate regulating a stream

61.zh: 取九二「鳴鶴在陰，其子和之」：鶴在松蔭下鳴叫，小鶴相和，象徵誠信感通。
61.en: a mother crane calling with her beak raised and her chick answering beside her under a pine branch

62.zh: 取卦辭「飛鳥遺之音，不宜上，宜下」：小鳥向下飛落、留下鳴聲，象徵小事可過、宜下不宜上。
62.en: a small swallow gliding downward toward a mountain ledge with its beak open in song

63.zh: 取大象「水在火上，既濟」：火爐上的水壺正沸，水火相濟，象徵已經完成，也提醒初吉終亂。
63.en: a bronze kettle of water simmering over a small brazier fire, steam rising in perfect balance

64.zh: 取卦辭「小狐汔濟，濡其尾」：小狐狸涉水將過岸，尾巴卻沾濕了，象徵事未完成、仍須謹慎。
64.en: a young fox wading across a shallow stream almost reaching the far bank, its bushy tail dipping into the water

peopleRule: All human figures are East Asian people with East Asian facial features and straight black hair, wearing ancient Chinese hanfu robes of the Han to Tang dynasties with Chinese hairstyles, hairpins and headwear; any halo is a round Dunhuang mural style Buddhist nimbus. No European faces, no blonde, brown or red hair, no curly hair, no laurel wreaths, no Western medieval, Greek or Roman clothing, no boots or leather backpacks, no Christian iconography, no European buildings or castles
